title: Use Smaller Plates To Lose Fat
hook: Buying smaller plates will make you eat less, and it's the easiest change you'll ever make.
body: You don't eat until you're full. You eat until the plate is empty. So the size of the plate decides how much you eat before you take the first bite. This works when you serve yourself. So tomorrow, measure your dinner plates. If they're 11 or 12 inches across, buy 9 inch plates and put the big ones away. Or start eating dinner off your salad plates tonight. You don't have to fight your appetite at every meal. Just buy smaller plates once.
